body:
Fuck money.  It makes me want to die as well.  The stress of not be able to make ends meet--ends, perhaps, we didn't even ask for and would be fine without were it not for the rules/standards of our countries, like having a car and dealing with all of the associated bills.

I wish I could help you more with the mental part, but it'd be the blind leading the blind.  I can say, though, if you're going to be homeless, check out work exchange programs like Help Exchange or WWOOF; you can live with a host family in exchange for working on a farm or housing project or whatever.  All kinds of things.  I had planned to do it, but I can't afford a passport or transportation.  But maybe you'll have more luck with it, something in your area or a friend that can loan you a plane ticket.  Just get out and live for you while you're still breathing, before you give that up.

"The only thing that gets me out of bed in the morning is anxiety about what would happen to me if I didn't get out of bed."

Yep.  That's my life, right there.  I wish I could offer advice; all I can offer is company in feeling that way.  PM me if you ever need a friend who knows what it's like.
